purpose: Authoritative Step-3 inventory and bounded authoring catalog. Runtime workflows are portable and validated against the equivalent embedded Rust contract.
resolution_rule: Each parameter record is the merge of record_templates[template] followed by the record's explicit fields.

direct_json_rule.applies_when: merged record is class A or B, eligible_for_internal_optimization=true, and json_exposed=true

production_binding_contract.fail_closed_rule: An enabled block cannot contain a parameter whose production binding status is deliberately_deferred.
production_binding_contract.conditional_noop_rule: An actively varied conditional parameter whose enabling predicate is false receives an immutable technical-infeasible trial record and is pruned before production evaluation; it cannot silently become a no-op.

classification_legend.B: structural method-family choice; compare only in explicitly declared blocks
classification_legend.C: numerical convergence or precision control; test adequacy, never optimize for identification yield
classification_legend.E: validation, reporting, artifact, or provenance-only control
classification_legend.F: unsafe, unimplemented, or currently unsupported optimization candidate
